brief: Somewhere on my desk to hang my headphones and keep my keys.

requirements.requirement: Somewhere on the desk to hang headphones
requirements.evidence: Hook plate accessory:0#1,0#0 (hex-acc-hook, two hooks) on the front face of the right-hand cell piece:1,0,0;full provides the hang point. No headphone prop exists in the catalog and hanging a cable-coil on this ground-level hook was refused (would hang through the bench), so the headphones themselves are not staged; the hook is at desk level rather than raised.

requirements.requirement: Somewhere on the desk to keep keys
requirements.evidence: Shallow third-depth tray bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-third in the left cell piece:0,0,0;full - an open, easy-grab drop-in tray for keys (staged with a phone prop standing in it, as no keys prop exists).

requirements.requirement: A single modest desk unit combining both
requirements.evidence: Two full cells joined by side connector connector:0#0,0|1,0, open faces capped (capOpenFaces) and joints locked (lockJoints); 12 parts, check_build ok, meshClash clear.

finish.summary: A compact two-cell desk tidy: the left cell holds a shallow open tray for keys (drop them in, grab them out), and the right cell carries a twin-hook plate on its front face for hanging headphones. Cells are joined with a side connector, open faces capped, joints locked. Staged with a phone in the tray and a coiled cable beside the unit. Note: no headphone/keys props exist to stage, and the configurator would not hang an item on the ground-level hook (it would pass through the bench), so headphones are shown by the hook itself rather than a prop.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
